original: なんだかんだ言っても、やっぱりまだトムのことが好きなんでしょ？

en.text: You can spin it however you like, but the truth is that you still like Tom, don't you?
No matter what you say, you still like Tom deep down, don't you?
It doesn't matter what you say, somewhere in your heart, you still like Tom, don't you?

2838081.reading: なんだかんだいっても
